channel.title: Chandamama Moonlight Stories — English
channel.description: Ancient Sanskrit children's tales from the December 1999 Chandamama magazine, retold in English for children ages 4-12. Free, forever.
channel.itunes:author: Chandamama Cultural Preservation Project
channel.itunes:subtitle: Sanskrit stories for children in English
channel.itunes:summary: Ancient Sanskrit children's tales from the December 1999 Chandamama magazine, retold in English for children ages 4-12. Each episode features culturally-rooted storytelling, gentle music, and interactive moments for young listeners.

item.title: Welcome to Chandamama — Uncle Moon's Story House
item.description: A warm introduction to the magical world of Chandamama. Meet Uncle Moonbeam, learn about the magazine's history, and discover what wonders await in the stories ahead.

item.title: The King and the Queen — A Royal Mystery
item.description: From the cover of the December 1999 issue: a king points to something far away, and his queen listens with wonder. What does he see? A treasure, a dragon, or a new adventure?

item.title: Dr. Rabbit's Puzzle — A Maze Adventure
item.description: Help Smita find her way to the dentist through a magical maze! A fun interactive story about dental health, bravery, and helping friends.
